title: a repeat save answers a step whose fields have since changed
line: the plan rewrites a step's fields after its one logged run, so ran_unchanged says it was never asked on these; a row source's connector then answers the step on its current fields, which must not stand for the holder's own page (fetches.openable reads per step_source, the holder); the same search saved again in the browser, other bytes and the same rows, is still a repeat of the earlier artifact, and the repeat path reads per step_source too, so it logs a none run under the holder on the step's current fields (the note naming the earlier artifact) instead of leaving the file in the inbox forever: the step is answered at its holder again

steps.say: the search saved once: a none run, the artifact logged on the step

expect.why: the first save is fresh: logged, not a repeat
answered on its current fields, the step is already off the list

steps.say: the plan rewrites the step's fields afterwards (a stand-in: a run written by hand on fields the step no longer carries, as a real field change would leave behind)

log.note: harness: standing in for the plan's own rewrite of this step's fields

expect.why: the step's latest run no longer matches its current fields, so a turn would send someone to it again

steps.say: a row source's connector answers the step on its current fields meanwhile (a stand-in: a run written by hand under C06, the row source, on the step's own fields as they stand) -- the holder itself still has nothing but the mismatched run

log.note: harness: standing in for a row source's connector answering the step on its current fields

expect.why: a row source's own run does not stand for the holder's page: the holder D03 has still not answered on the step's current fields, so the list still prints it

steps.say: Reiko Diane Davidson's search of FamilySearch's New Jersey marriages, saved once: a none run, the artifact logged on her 1988 marriage step, held at C09 (a holder with a connector, so never on the fetch list)

expect.why: the first save is fresh: logged, not a repeat

steps.say: the plan rewrites her step's fields afterwards (the same stand-in as above)

log.note: harness: standing in for the plan's own rewrite of this step's fields

steps.say: a row source's connector answers her step on its current fields meanwhile (a stand-in: a run written by hand under C08, a source of the row) -- the holder itself still has nothing but the mismatched run

log.note: harness: standing in for a row source's connector answering the step on its current fields

steps.say: the same search saved again in the browser two and a half hours later, as the archive holds it: other bytes, the same five rows, still a repeat of the artifact the first save archived

expect.why: the rows are those the first save already archived
nothing new to archive: removed as a repeat

a fourth run, on the step's current fields again, is logged under the holder (C09), the step's own source, naming the earlier artifact, no artifact of its own -- not under C08, the row source that already answered these fields but does not stand for the holder's page
